semantic_uniqueness.method: Compare feature/mechanism, workflow/transaction, failure class, evidence pattern, remediation path, question fingerprint and diagram topology against the rolling inventory. Candidate-only historical records are retained conservatively.
semantic_uniqueness.notes: Cross-product near-matches were reviewed manually; EDM exact-record matching was distinguished from FortiSASE API-based CASB/DLP; LoRaWAN from Wi-Fi association/roaming; MACsec from L2 MCLAG; agentless ZTNA from agent-based pre-logon/browser controls.

community_sweep.notes: Only FortiAnalyzer post-reboot Device Manager status was a directly matched recent scenario. Other recent results were not paired when their mechanism differed from the lesson.

administration_guide_sweep.notes: Several direct Fortinet Document Library page opens returned HTTP 403; indexed official documentation text and accessible release/guide material were used. The report does not claim full direct-page inspection for blocked sources.

lessons.notes: All lessons explain feature purpose, object relationships, control/data flow, configuration or source-supported procedure, observables, failure boundaries and operational troubleshooting.

diagrams.notes: One duplicate create attempt for fortisiem-headless.svg returned 422 because the file already existed; the existing SVG was independently fetched and validated, so no asset was missing.
